name: Core Keeper
hint: Dedicated server for the co-op mining sandbox, joined by Game ID

WORLD_NAME.title: World name
WORLD_NAME.description: Steam players join with the Game ID printed in the app's logs after "Started session with info:" (Join Game, then paste the Game ID). The connection goes through Steam's relay, so no port is needed.

WORLD_SEED.title: World seed
WORLD_SEED.description: Blank for a random seed. Only used when the world is first created.

WORLD_MODE.title: World mode
WORLD_MODE.description: 0 is Normal, 1 Hard, 2 Creative and 4 Casual. Only used when the world is first created; switching between Creative and the other modes later is not supported.
